sdvmodels

A data package that hosts the fitted models used by cfbfastR and the wider SportsDataverse ecosystem, in the way fastrmodels hosts the models of nflfastR. The models are the cfb_model_artifacts release of sportsdataverse-data, the single bundle that both cfbfastR and sportsdataverse-py score with, re-packaged byte for byte.

Data freshness and pipeline status for every SportsDataverse dataset: sportsdataverse.org/status.

Installation

You can install the released version of sdvmodels from CRAN with:

install.packages("sdvmodels")

And the development version from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("sportsdataverse/sdvmodels")

What is in it

Object Model Objective
cfb_ep_model Expected points (next score) multi:softprob, 7 classes
cfb_wp_spread_model Win probability with the point spread binary:logistic
cfb_wp_naive_model Win probability without the spread binary:logistic
cfb_wp_ot_reach_model Probability the game reaches overtime binary:logistic
cfb_fg_model Field goal make probability binary:logistic
cfb_fd_model Fourth down yards-gained distribution multi:softprob, 76 classes
cfb_two_pt_model Two point conversion binary:logistic
cfb_xpass_model Expected pass binary:logistic
cfb_cp_model Completion probability binary:logistic
cfb_cp_air_yards_model Completion probability where air yards are known binary:logistic
cfb_qbr_model Quarterback rating reg:squarederror
cfb_punt_distribution Net punt yardage by field position data frame
cfb_field_position_ep Expected points by yards to goal data frame
cfb_model_cards One model card per model list
cfb_model_manifest The bundle manifest (feature contracts, SHA-256, EP class order) list

Quickstart

Each xgboost model is the raw UBJ byte vector of the released file, so it loads with any xgboost version that reads UBJ:

library(sdvmodels)

ep <- xgboost::xgb.load.raw(cfb_ep_model)
xgboost::getinfo(ep, "feature_name")
#> [1] "TimeSecsRem"          "yards_to_goal"        "distance"            
#> [4] "down_1"               "down_2"               "down_3"              
#> [7] "down_4"               "pos_score_diff_start"

cfb_model_manifest$ep_class_contract$class_order
#> [1] "TD"         "Opp_TD"     "FG"         "Opp_FG"     "Safety"    
#> [6] "Opp_Safety" "No_Score"

Scoring a play, and the rest of the feature contracts, are walked through in Getting started.

Updating the models

The models are trained and published by the sportsdataverse-py model pipeline. To re-package a new bundle, download the release into data-raw/artifacts and run data-raw/MODELS.R:

gh release download cfb_model_artifacts --repo sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data --dir data-raw/artifacts --clobber
Rscript -e 'source("data-raw/MODELS.R")'

Follow the SportsDataverse (@SportsDataverse) on X and star this repo

sdvmodels is part of the SportsDataverse. Related packages:

  • cfbfastR: college football play-by-play, scored with these models
  • cfb4th: college football fourth-down decisions
  • sportsdataverse-py: the Python side, which trains and scores the same bundle
  • fastrmodels: the nflverse package sdvmodels mirrors
  • sportsdataverse-R: the SportsDataverse R meta-package
